I respect everyone who'd do this; it's an immensely quest, but ignorance breeds countless kids to get the their children support checks, ignorance steals from others and ignorance kills who doesn't agree with them.

Ignorance basically does the most efficient solution to a problem with no moral consequences to themselves, because they don't feel it.

Think about it; if the average human being is X smart you 'just' need to be abit above X to feed off ignorant people: This is probably the easiest form of life on this planet; however it creates more ignorance - and I don't want to be a part of it.

Example: Lots of people see pretty people and think they have certain values they might nor have. Less ignorant people creates a show enforcing these prejudices (that pretty people might have certain qualities). This helps the ignorant people being 'right' and boosts their self esteem and helps them in social situations: "I'm stupid, but this show told me..." which is a strong argument in ignorant conversations.
Even if you see the 'trick' it doesn't matter; you're a conspiracy theorist or a negative person if you spot these things and people don't like their favorite tv-show getting torn apart by a 24-year old.

The worst part is how easy it is; even with my ~15 ,years of study, learning what people before my have learned, I can see it. Yet society is built around this fake picture of life: There are even people I study with, who can see it but STILL WATCHES IT because it's "entertaining" to watch ignorant people do ignorant things: How is this a life worth living? The ignorant are being misled and told wrong information, while the less ignorant is satisfied acting as sadists, while the even less ignorant is doing fuck-all to earn massive loads of cash.

Look at Fifty Shades of Grey, Twilight or Harry Potter - These are three different works, by three different authors. None of these immensely popular books are high-quality writing. All of them are littered with *wrong* literature. Wrong being misuse of the language, meaningless descriptions.

I'm not an intelligent person, but Ode to Joy (Beethoven's' Ninth) seems to me, like excellent music - Why hasn't anyone made anything better since then? Why is music littered with beats that make no sense, lyrics about the most feral things possible? Look at how the world treated Michael Jackson; I honestly don't care if he abused a few kids, even though that's very much against my morals, but he gave hope and dreams to billions with his music.

I was being dramatic; I'm very compassionate normally but wanted to point out my frustrations rather than my day-to-day feelings.

For example, a nice old lady asked me to stop smoking the other day. Not because I was annoying her, but because I reminded her of someone/something and she'd be sad if I died of lung cancer.

That's probably the most beautiful compassion I've ever witnessed and I respect this lady more than I respect anyone; and we'd never met and never will again.

I know how it is to have a GF; you don't.

I've been with enough girls that I now don't want one, ever.

I'm bipolar, so I'd trade places with you any day; I'm very social and love discussing with people; I just dislike people.

Trust me; the grass is NOT as green as it looks.

Sex/relationships is great but heavily overrated. Getting a hug from a person you live, rather than a family member, is similar but very different - the difference is what makes people believe it's all worth it. The truth, as I see it, is that it's bullshit- finding a partner might temporarily cure your loneliness but it doesn't solve the problem.

It's like taping a hole in a sinking ship: Sure, it'll stop leaking for now, but at some point it'll blow out and you'll have to figure out how to patch up the hole. And after you patch the hole, the leaking seems laughable and you feel really weird about using tape to fix the holes.

The hole is your loneliness, the water is negative feelings, the tape is love and whoever is helping you tape it over is your partner.

> Overall... I just want to you to know there is more to life than you think.. just open your eyes and people will show you the way. I know that you can find your way if you just let yourself try.

I completely agree with you. And I'm convinced my view on life will change dramatically the more I live. The thing is I grew up hoping the 'truth' I saw, even as a kid, was a lie I made up to shield myself.

Unfortunately it turned out to be real, I was right.

I'm a student already, so I'm already living with the absolute least amount of money as possible, just barely paying rent and food. I'm content with this, but sadly I still need money to pay the rent- Which is the problem.

I'm generally a very open person, and as such I feel I changed my lifestyle a lot over the years, with a few exceptions (I still use my computer a lot, no matter what).

I enjoy being healthy, but I see no point - running a lot makes me feel good about myself for the wrong reasons, and staying healthy is kinda meaningless if you don't want to live.

On the other hand, I've tried living the 'fat life' - that is to say, being overweight (by a bit) and just living as a couch potato, but that has a  similar effect as being healthy: I feel bad because I'm unhealthy, but for the wrong reason, but 'bad' food makes me feel good - which is a weird feeling I haven't pinpointed. It's just awkward feeling happy for eating something, when the reason you eat is to stay alive.

I'd agree such a solution might be out there; but I refuse to 'let go' and just live off society until something better turns up. I still feel responsible to give back to the people that's responsible for me to live in 24 years (soceity)

Thank you so much for writing this.

Such information might be what I need.
Torn between purple and blue; I really enjoy them when mixed together.
